entries.effect: the run channelIndex of every source pixel, sixteen bits, into the destination's own pixel, and nothing past the destination's own width; the channel index is checked on the value against the header's [0,3], so an index of -1 or 4 is kvImageInvalidParameter; it takes `kvImageDoNotTile`, `kvImageGetTempBufferSize` and `kvImagePrintDiagnosticsToConsole` (0x100) and refuses every other bit; a NULL buffer is kvImageNullPointerArgument where the release answers it and the port's own refusal where the release dies on it, a destination larger than the source is kvImageRoiLargerThanInputBuffer, GetTempBufferSize does no work and answers zero, and a value outside the range the header names for it is kvImageInvalidParameter
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 (Conversion.h) for the contract, the copyMask bit order and the return codes it names; the host's own vImage, held against the port case by case by tests/backports/host/vimagechannels, which computes the expected destination from that contract before asking the host, compares every byte of every row including the bytes neither side may write, and surveys the whole flag word and a table of copyMask values for every function of the family; the release's own armv7 caches, which say which release first exports each name
